_doc: Map 1 world machinery tuning (MAPS.md: power-on event, pylon holdouts, lift). exfil: the campaign beacon at the yard gate (T-033), see map00.json for the fields.

requiem._doc: T-181 the Four Bells made easier (QuestBell): each small bell's shot box is bell_hit_box_m wide (a near miss rings it; the 0.64 m box let bursts and the specimen tank's frame eat the rounds), an explosion within bell_splash_m rings it, and from bells_glow_after (the music box opened) the four live bells glow faintly and chime their note every bells_chime_s, so they can be found by eye and ear; a bell already rung in this run never resets the sequence (map01_requiem s6 repeat_ok). The Chapel bell stays lit longer (bell_lit_solo / bell_lit_coop below; relight cooldown 60 and summon delay 20 are the defaults) and s4 counts the Foreman near the altar too (its near / near_m).
requiem._bell_lit: T-181: the Chapel bell stays lit 150 s solo / 120 s co-op (was 90 / 75): the Foreman comes 20 s after it lights, and the squad had a minute to bring him into the Chapel and kill him there; relight cooldown and summon delay unchanged

round_bosses._doc: T-240 the undead horses on Kaltenbrunn: on the surface only

T-272: der Fuhrmann leads the round-30 horde that hits the Sherman (sherman_event): heard as the tank parks in the forecourt (about 19 s after the round starts), in by the north gate behind it as the dead go for it

round_boss_arena._doc: T-240 the surface yards only (the navmesh is baked for a 0.5 m agent and the doors are 2 m, but the lift cage, the stairs and the galleries are no place for a horse): it comes in by the north gate (arrive; without it: the far side of these zones from the squad, on the yard's level) and never follows below ground (the siege rule).

horses.name: YardHorse
horses._doc: T-271 the mine's cart horse (T-240's rideable horse, T-262's tack chest), tied at a hitching rail on the Minehead yard's east wall between the drums in the corner and the Rail Yard door (the door is 6 m south of the rail, the chest 4.5 m). yaw -90 = it faces the rail and the wall (+x). zones: the two surface yards (the Rail Yard once its door is open); never the Kaue's doorways that lead below, the Administration or the barracks. The rail's collider is on the map-edge layer, the chest has none: the baked navmesh is untouched. Measured by probe_map_site and walked by smoke_map_detail.

sherman_event._doc: T-272 Kaltenbrunn's Sherman (sherman.json; ShermanEvent): THE FULL EVENT, as on the Inn. Round 30: it comes up out of the valley along the buried rail line's terrace, turns west along the north road and in through the yard's north gate (YardGate swings open for it and shuts behind it; the gateway's collider never moves) and parks in the forecourt between the gate and the headframe, facing the yard (route; park and park_yaw are its last point and leg). The dead rise round it in the Minehead yard (assault_zones: the squad's own zone, open from round 1, so the fight is always reachable) and go for it; der Fuhrmann comes in by the gate as it parks (round_bosses' arrival). If it holds it covers the yard for rounds 31..39. Round 40: the dive bomber comes down the valley on it (stuka_target is only for a match where both tanks were lost: the locomotive), then the raid: bombs on the open yards (bomb_zones), every roof a shelter (shelter_roof) and so is everything in shelter_zones. Before T-272 this block was the raid only ("tank": false): there was no way in.
sherman_event._doc_route: T-272 the shelf north of the yard is flat at y 0 (KaltenTerrain SHELF_MIN z -25): from the rail line's head (the terrace comes up out of the valley there) along the trodden north road between the drifts (x 2..18 and 23..37 at z -7..-1) and straight south through the gateway (x 17.6..22.4; the hull is 2.62 m wide). Parked: centre (20, 0, 4.4) facing south, hull z 1.4..7.3, 2.7 m clear of the hoist house, the lanes either side of it 6 m and more (probe_map_site --route).

arrival.banner_small: A SHERMAN IS COMING UP OUT OF THE VALLEY

sherman_event._doc_drive: T-272 where a player may drive it here: the forecourt in front of the hoist house only (x 15.2..24.8, the hoist house's own width, so a hull left anywhere in it, or its wreck after round 40, never stands in the 3 m lanes past the gatehouse and the winding house; z 0.4..9.7, between the north wall and the hoist house). Room to turn on the spot (a 6.5 m circle) and lay the gun on the yard; never the yard's lanes, the Kaue or the rail yard. The disc keeps the campaign's exfil beacon by the gate clear.
